# Fastify Gotchas

> Known Fastify patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Writing through `reply.raw` bypasses the whole Fastify plugin chain, including CORS](reply-raw-bypasses-plugin-chain.md): `reply.raw.writeHead()` flushes the head with only the headers you pass, hijacking the reply so `onSend` never runs — `@fastify/cors`, helmet and compression silently stop applying to that route. The server looks correct (clean 200, curl passes, server-side tests green) and only a browser rejects it, so an SSE stream keeps serving a healthy response that every client throws away: the UI shows its page-load fetch forever and every cache invalidation riding the stream dies app-wide. Usually mis-filed as a Better Auth `toNodeHandler` quirk; the trap is `reply.raw`. HIGH.
